transcript_segments.text: i opened my laptop to answer one email
reasonable adult very brief
47 minutes later i was reading public fountain history in prague
because someone wrote just circling back
and my brain said
lovely
let's build a civilization
i've got too many windows open in my skull
each one playing audio at a tasteful volume
there's a tab for rent and a tab for shame
a tab where i prove i'm not to blame
a tab where i rehearse one joke from tuesday
and another where i search is tired of personality
thinking six thoughts with no permission
one says text your friend back
one says invent a better tax system
one says remember that time in 2009
you said you're too too a waiter who told you to enjoy your meal
important archive national shame
i can see every angle except the plain ones
of imaginary course before the case comes
call it intelligence if you want the nice word
mostly it's a knife drawer in a bouncy castle
i know too much about things i can't change
i name every cloud but still stand in the rain
too many windows too much light
i can see the whole map and still miss the right
come back to the room come back to the floor
the world is not asking for one thought more
if i go quiet i'm not leaving you
i'm sorting the noise from the signal and blue
too many windows open at once
and one small heart trying to answer the front
also if genius was the plan
someone should have included a better laundry module
people say you think too much
like i do it for the aesthetic
like i wake up stretch and choose
premium anxiety with unlimited tabs
i would love to have one thought one clean thought
like toast
not toast as evidence of agricultural history
childhood safety late capitalism
and how i still don't own a proper butter dish
i'm at a party
buy the coats again performing normal
for some almost friends
they talk about holidays houses dogs
i talk for three minutes about train platform acoustics
then watch my sentence land in the room
like a chair thrown by a ghost
nobody's cruel
that's the worst bit
they're kind
they nod
they do that little smile that says
this person is a podcast with shoes
so i laugh first
make it tidy
turn the wound into a party trick
say sorry brains a bit loud today
as if today is the outlier blessed
too many windows too much light
i can see the whole map and still miss the right
come back to the room come back to the floor
the world is not asking for one thought more
if i go quiet i'm not leaving you
i'm sorting the noise from the signal and blue
too many windows open at once
and one small heart trying to answer the front
yeah here is the lonely part
not dramatic lonely
no black coat no cliff
no rain behaving symbolically
just the quiet little distance between what i mean and what arrives
i can explain a feeling so precisely
it dies of paperwork
i can build a palace round a wound and forget to let anyone in
i have frightened people with the speed of my care
and i have corrected a detail in a story
when the correct answer was clearly
hold their hand you absolute spreadsheet
and i am trying truly
i am trying to be less brilliant at being elsewhere
less fluent in escape
more present in the stupid holy room
where someone says you're right
and the miracle answer is not a diagram
it's not really can you sit with me
maybe the mind isn't a courtroom
maybe it's just a crowded flat with bad wiring and good intentions
maybe not every thought needs entered into evidence
maybe i can leave some tabs unsolved
let prague keep its mountains
let tuesday keep its joke
let the old embarrassment retire by the coast
maybe clever isn't always climbing
maybe clever is noticing the guitar in the corner
pretty going cold
the friend on the sofa waiting through my weather
maybe love is not impressed by processing speed
maybe love is the hand that closes three windows and says
look the room survived without your supervision
too many windows too much light
i can see the whole map and still miss the ride
come back to the room come back to the floor
the world is not asking for one for more
if i go quiet just stay nearby
i'm learning the shape of a simpler sky
too many windows but one open door
and one small heart coming back to the floor
i answered the email by the way
eventually it said sounds good
two words 47 minutes
honestly that's efficiency
if you include the fountains
